content:
Right now, you and I communicate **only through text**—you type your questions or messages, and I respond with written answers. I **can't use a microphone or speakers** to talk with you by voice.

Some platforms or apps use **speech-to-text** or **text-to-speech** features alongside ChatGPT. If you're using one of those, you might be able to speak to me (your speech gets converted to text that I read), and you might hear my responses read out loud by your device (using text-to-speech). But I, as an AI, don't "hear" or "speak" myself—it's all text on my end.

If you want to use voice, you can:
- Use your device’s voice assistant or dictation feature to speak your questions.
- Use a screen reader or text-to-speech engine for my replies to be read aloud.

Do you need help setting any of that up, or are you looking for a particular way to interact?
